description: This file contains functions and types for managing inbound message debouncing, including resolving debounce times, creating debouncers, and handling buffered message items with scheduled flushes.

methods.name: resolveMs
methods.description: Resolves a value to a finite non-negative number of milliseconds, or undefined if invalid.

methods.name: resolveChannelOverride
methods.description: Resolves override debounce milliseconds for a specific channel based on configuration.

methods.name: createInboundDebouncer
methods.description: Creates a debouncer for inbound messages with configurable buffering, timing, and callback handling.
